parent_objective: build no-policy source-history corpus expansion plan
blocked_by: M1314 admits no-policy expansion plan builder
supersedes: further objective tuning on the current 38-pair source-history corpus

public_gates: M1315 must not use private holdout
M1315 must preserve actor input contract
M1315 must output a deterministic expansion plan
M1315 must report coverage gaps instead of fabricating unsupported families
forbidden_shortcuts: do not fabricate unsupported source families

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the first no-policy plan for expanded source-history corpus coverage
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: planning infrastructure only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if plan builder cannot find enough source families
stop if pair-disjoint folds cannot be built
stop if the plan requires actor input expansion
stop if plan uses pair-specific weights
fallback_plan: if plan is admissible, route to no-policy materialization design
if source coverage is insufficient, route to source-generator update design
if fold balance fails, route to fold-balancing redesign
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: first implementation in source-history corpus expansion branch

admission_evidence: M1314 defines expansion axes and acceptance criteria
M1313 identifies scenario_sampling_failure as primary blocker
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1315 is a corpus plan and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: plan richer matched command-response history pairs for later diagnostics
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1273 and M1280 source-history substrate plus M1314 expansion design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If coverage is insufficient, route to source-generator update design rather than policy training.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The existing source artifacts can support a deterministic expanded source-history corpus plan with materially broader fault-family and fold coverage before another objective run.
success_criteria: planned_source_pairs >= 240 or unsupported coverage gaps are explicitly reported
planned_pair_probe_groups >= 480 or unsupported coverage gaps are explicitly reported
source_fault_family_count >= 6 or unsupported coverage gaps are explicitly reported
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1315 passes as planning infrastructure if it writes deterministic expansion plan artifacts without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, pair-specific weights, or actor-input expansion.
